summary: 62-year-old hiker dislocated a hip on Blue Lakes Trail; the team packaged them in a vac mat, lowered them by litter with big wheel, and Care Flight of the Rockies flew them to a hospital.
notes: Post dated 9/26 says 'call out midday yesterday'. Airlifted to hospital from a backcountry landing zone; CareFlight of the Rockies.
